newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission sees 16.1 mln tns 96/97 wheat exports - Coceral.
newsitem.headline: Commission sees 16.1 mln tns 96/97 wheat exports - Coceral.

text.p: European Union exports of soft wheat and processed products are expected to total 16.1 million tonnes in 1996/97 (July/June), according to European Commission data published by the EU grain trade lobby Coceral.
The Commission did not give figures for 1995/96.
The forecast, compiled by the Commission's directorate general for agriculture, includes 11.8 million tonnes of wheat grain, 3.8 million tonnes of flour and 570,000 tonnes of wheat aid.
It was based on an EU grain crop of 204.3 million tonnes, including 90.9 million of soft wheat, presented at a meeting of the EU cereals advisory committee on February 7.
Commission officials could not be reached for comment.
Coceral forecast EU exports of soft wheat and processed products at 15.0 million tonnes in 1996/97 based on a crop of 203.1 million tonnes, of which 91 million tonnes of soft wheat.
The crop was up from 175.8 million tonnes and soft wheat from 80.1 million tonnes in 1995/96, according to Coceral.
The Commission forecast EU exports of barley grain and processed products at 7.0 million tonnes in 1996/97.
Coceral put barley and product exports at 8.3 million tonnes in 1996/97, up from 4.5 million last season.
The Commission forecast overall grain and product exports of 29.0 million tonnes in 1996/97, of which 20.2 million tonnes of grain, 7.6 million tonnes of products and 1.2 million tonnes of aid.
For its part, Coceral put total 1996/97 grain and product exports at 25.8 million tonnes, up from 19.3 million tonnes last season.
The Commission saw a residual market balance of 7.9 million tonnes of grain, including 3.7 million tonnes of soft wheat, at the end of 1996/97.
Coceral forecast a residual carry out, including intervention and speculation stocks, grain at customs and in transport, of 9.8 million tonnes.
